statement.zh: 阿斯马尔与哈法杰东方研究所发掘记录了 Gimilsin（舒辛）神庙与统治者宫殿（OIP 43）及椭圆形神庙（OIP 53）；分期标签依原报告，须与现代修订对照。
statement.en: At Tell Asmar and Khafajah, Oriental Institute excavations documented the Gimilsin (Shu-Sin) Temple and Palace of the Rulers (OIP 43) and the Temple Oval (OIP 53); period labels follow those reports and need modern cross-check.

editorial.notes: Fact about published Diyala excavation reports. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: temple/palace assemblages first.
